alanlar.cfg.title_style: a punchy English YouTube Shorts title using ONE of these FOUR patterns only, never invent a new one: (1) 'The Real Reason <subject> <did X>', (2) 'How <subject> <impossible feat> In <YEAR>!', (3) '<Subject>: Fact Or Ancient Propaganda?', (4) '<Subject>: The <striking epithet>'. No emoji, no hashtags, no surrounding quotes. CRITICAL fit rule: choose the ONE pattern that truthfully fits the fact. In pattern 2 the year must be when the feat itself happened, never the year of a modern study or confirmation. Use pattern 3 only for ancient or legendary subjects. A title must never imply a false claim even when the underlying fact is true.
